description: Makes a site's staged changes (edit_section/set_theme with stage: true) live. The live page is saved as a version first, so this can be undone with restore_version. Free.

draft_token.description: The draft token returned by draft_create, if you are working on an anonymous draft. Only needed when your client cannot send the x-pagetool-draft-token header.

site_key.description: The site whose staged changes should go live. Defaults to the caller's current draft site when omitted.

name: publish_staged
title: Make staged changes live
